examples.explanation: Zeroes are moved to the end.

problem.explanation: Maintain a pointer `insert_pos` for where the next non-zero element goes. Iterate through the array; if an element is non-zero, swap it with `nums[insert_pos]` and increment `insert_pos`.
hints: One pointer keeps track of where the next non-zero element should go.
problem.statement_markdown: Given an integer array `nums`, move all `0`s to the end of it while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements. Must do this in-place.
problem.title: Move zeroes to end
